senses.gloss:
(उ) वृतु r. 1st cl. (वर्त्तते)
To be, to exist, to stay, to stand, to be fixed or stable.
r. 4th cl. (वृत्यते)
1 To choose, to select or appoint.
2 To serve.
r. 10th cl. (वर्त्तयति)
1 To shine.
2 To speak.
With अति prefixed,
1 To surpass or overcome.
2 To pass over or beyond.
3 To transgress.
With अनु,
1 To follow, to imitate.
2 To proceed.
With अप,
To turn back or round.
With आङ्,
1 To turn round, to revolve.
2 To do repeatedly.
With नि,
To make artificially.
With नि or निर्,
To stop, to cease, to complete or terminate.
With परि,
1 To surround.
2 To exchange.
3 To excel, to be pre-eminent.
4 To advance.
5 To retreat or return.
6 To turn round.
With प्र,
To engage in any active pursuit.
With प्रति and नि,
To go away, to depart.
With वि,
1 To roll, to whirl, to turn round.
2 To revolve.
With वि and नि,
To return.
With वि and परि,
To revolve, (in the mind.)
With सम and अभि,
To leap.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Chosen, selected, preferred.
2 Agreed or assented to.
3 Served.
4 Covered, screened, defended.
5 Affected by.
6 Vitiated, spoiled.
E.
वृ to prefer, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Chosen, selected, appointed.
2 Done, performed, engaged in or undertaken.
3 Past, gone, been.
4 Over, finished.
5 Dead, deceased.
6 Read, studied, read through.
7 Covered.
8 Round.
9 Firm, hard.
10 Unobstructed, unimpaired.
11 Famous, celebrated.
n. (-त्तं)
1 Verse, metre.
2 Conduct, observance of enjoined practice in private or social life.
3 Practice, profession, means of gaining a subsistence.
4 Procedure, event, occurrence.
5 A circle.
m. (-त्तः)
A tortoise.
E.
वृत to be, &c., aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Selecting, choosing, preferring, appointing.
2 Soliciting, asking, requesting.
3 Surrounding, encompassing.
4 An enclosure, a place enclosed for particular cultivation, and especially that of the Piper betel, which in many parts of India is surrounded and screened by mats.
5 Hiding, secreting.
E.
वृ to choose, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Livelihood, profession, means of acquiring subsistence.
2 Style or character of dramatic representation, or composition, considered to be of four sorts, or Kauśikī, which exhibits love or passion; Bhāratī, which appears to implies declamation especially; Sātvatī, of which the subject is virtue and heroism; and Ārabhaṭī, which treats of magic, delusion, wrath, and battle.
3 Style in general.
4 Gloss, comment, explanation, exposition.
5 Being, abiding, staying.
6 Seizing, stopping, withholding, restraining.
7 Circumference of a circle.
E.
वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Surrounding, encompassing.
m. (-रः)
A plant, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.)
E.
वृति surrounding, कृ to make, खच् aff.

n. (-ण्डं)
Sector or segment of a circle.
E.
वृत्त, and खण्ड part.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Who or what knows men's actions.
E.
वृत्त, and ज्ञ who knows.

ind.
In or relating to observance or duty, by caste or duty, not implying agency; as वृत्ततः पापं "by or according to caste, a sin".
E.
तसि substituted for the termination of the third case.

m. (-ष्पः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.)
E.
वृत्त round, and पुष्प a flower.

n. (-लं)
Black pepper.
E.
वृत्त round, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Discharging the duties of caste or calling, correct, well-conducted.
E.
वृत्त, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Well-behaved or conducted, behaving with propriety.
E.
वृत्त duty, and सम्पन्न perfect in.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Worthless, mean, vile.
E.
वृत्त, and षद to go (from), घिनुण् aff.

m. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Discharging the duties of caste or calling.
E.
वृत्त established practice, and स्थ who stays.

f. (-र्द्धिः)
Holiness, sanctity, resulting from observance of the rules of life and study of scripture.
E.
वृत्त conduct, अध्ययन study, and ऋद्धि^1 prosperity, increase.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301. note: The 'r' is print error.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
Obedient, conforming to rule.
E.
वृत्त, अनु according to, वर्त्तिन् abiding.

m. (-रः)
Conforming to prescribed practice.
E.
वृत्त, and अनुसार following.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Conforming to established rule or practice, doing what is enjoined or proper.
E.
वृत्तानुसार, and इनि aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Tidings, rumor, intelligence.
2 Sort, kind, difference.
3 Mode, manner.
4 Whole.
5 Interval, rest, leisure, opportunity.
6 Topic, subject.
7 A tale, a story.
8 Property, nature.
9 Alone, solitary.
E.
वृत्त observance, &c., and अन्त, end, term.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Attracted by or impelled to for the sake of subsistence.
E.
वृत्ति, and कर्षित attracted.

f. (-ता)
1 State of existence.
2 Profession, subsistence.
E.
वृत्ति, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वृत्तित्वं.

n. (-नं)
Giving maintenance, &c.
E.
वृत्ति, and दान giving.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Abiding, stationary.
E.
वृत्ति, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-तुः)
Cause or means of subsistence.
E.
वृत्ति, and हेतु cause.

mfn. (-जाः-जा-जः)
Mighty, irresistible.
E.
वृत्त, and ओजस् strength.

mfn. (-त्त्यः-त्त्या-त्त्यं)
1 To be chosen, preferable, eligible.
2 Excellent, eminent.
3 To be abided or stayed.
E.
वृत to select, aff. क्यप् or वृञ् with the same aff., and तुक् augment.

ind.
For the sake of subsistence.
E.
वृत्ति, and अर्थम् for the sake of.

m. (-सः)
Alliteration suited to any style or expression.
E.
वृत्ति, and अनुप्रास alliteration.

m. (-यः)
Means of subsistence.
E.
वृत्ति, and उपाय means.

m. (-त्रः)
1 An enemy.
2 Darkness.
3 A demon slain by INDRA.
4 A cloud.
5 A name of INDRA.
6 The name of a mountain.
7 Sound, noise.
E.
वृत to be or abide, Uṇādi aff. रक्.

m. (-द्विट्)
INDRA.
E.
वृत्र the demon, and द्विष् the enemy.

m. (-नः)
A kind of potherb, described by some as a sort of cucumber.
E.
वृच INDRA, and भोजन food.

m. (-हा)
INDRA.
E.
वृत्र a demon, and हन् slayer.

m. (-रिः)
INDRA.
E.
वृत्र a demon, and अरि an enemy.
